<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Shenron''' is the Earth dragon. Gather the seven '''Earth Dragon Balls''' scattered around the world spawn of the Overworld, place them together and right-click one to summon him. He grants '''one wish''' per summon, chosen from the list below.
</translate>

<translate>
== Summoning Shenron == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
{{Main|Dragons and Wishes}}
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Find the balls with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] (Earth), crafted from a Radar's Chip (Earth) and a Radar's CPU (Earth). Place all seven within 5 blocks of each other: once the set is complete the balls glow and chime, and right-clicking one summons Shenron. Only the player who summoned him can make the wish.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:7-->
While Shenron is out, the Overworld sky turns into a starry night sky (only visually). If nobody makes a wish, he leaves after 10 minutes. Either way, the balls scatter across the world again.
</translate>

<translate>
== Wishes == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Pick one of these wishes each time you summon Shenron:
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:38-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:39-->
* '''Power Boost''' follows your current stat cost, so it is worth as much late in the game as early on. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]].
* After a '''Reset Story Progress''', story rewards shrink on every new run (by default 50% on the second run, 25% on the third, and so on).
* The revive wish only works on players who are dead in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]] and online. Revived players lose their halo and are fully alive again.
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest ''The Cracked Dragon Balls'' asks you to summon Shenron.
</translate>
